data_facts_with_para.paragraph: A single-person-middle-income-earner in the US makes between US$26,000 and US$78,000 in a year (as per 2016 data) and a middle-income-three-member-household earns about US$45,000 to US$135,000,according to the Pew Research Center.

facts.fact_content: A single-person-middle-income-earner in the US makes between US$26,000 and US$78,000 in a year.
A middle-income-three-member-household in the US earns about US$45,000 to US$135,000.
